title: F1 2000 Boat
description: This is a Formula 1 2000 texturepack by AdamixGaming, NotGatoz  and Jerpix | required OptiFine!!!
body:
If you want to appreciate our work, you will find links to our buycoffees in the "License" file in the texturepack.

Mercedes Safety Car
  
    All boat with chest (with bamboo raft)
  
    No command is needed to spawn the Safety Car

oak_boat

    Ferrari 3,4
    Sauber 16,17

spruce_boat

    Prost 14,15
    BAR 22,23 (if older version)

birch_boat

    Jordan 5,6

jungle_boat

    Jaguar 7,8

acacia_boat

    Mclaren 1,2

dark_oak_boat

  Arrows 18,19

cherry_boat

    Minardi 20,21

mangrove_boat

    Williams 9,10

bamboo_raft

    Benetton 11,12

(if new version)

pale_oak

    BAR 22,23

**How to specify**

    Fixed version only

/summon boat ~ ~ ~ {Type:"<oak | spruce | birch | jungle | acacia | dark_oak | cherry | mangrove | bamboo | pale_oak (if new version)>",CustomName:"\"<car number>_<slick | wet>\""}

Example

/summon boat ~ ~ ~ {Type:"oak",CustomName:"\"3_slick\""} (old version)
/summon pale_oak_boat ~ ~ ~ {CustomName:""22_wet\""} (new version)
